name: tern
description: Self-hosted outreach inbox: a Gmail-style web client for any JMAP mailbox, with sequences, humanised send timing and a local LLM drafting assistant.

scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
